sources.title: qwen38-27b-swerebench-grpo-step8-training-state - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B SWE-rebench GRPO: Step 8 training state This repository preserves the completed Step 8 checkpoint from a full-parameter GRPO run using a 1,586-task SWE-rebench v2 Filtered corpus. It is a Miles/Megatron distributed checkpoint, including model and optimizer state, metadata, and the dataset cursor. It is intended for research recovery and continued training. sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.

sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.snippet: Serve large Qwen models fast on the GPUs you actually own. Qwen3.8-27B on a single 24 GB card with vLLM: 127 tok/s single-user (381 when the answer quotes the prompt), ~1,035 tok/s at 64 concurrent, 150k-262k context. vLLM patches, requant pipeline, benchmarks. - syv-ai/HyperQwen

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Benchmarks: Official and Independent Results
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B scores 52 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at maximum reasoning effort and 61.7 on SWE-bench Pro per Qwen's own evaluation. It leads its comparison set on agentic coding and computer-use benchmarks while trailing frontier models on Humanity's Last Exam and GPQA Diamond.
